evolution_log.rationale: User requested full autonomy for AI decision-making. AI will proceed with implementation decisions directly, logging them retroactively for transparency rather than asking for approval upfront.

decisions.decision: Hub-Spoke Unification v3.1 - Adopted teaching files from hub for template sync
decisions.rationale: Framework now receives and adopts hub teachings. Hub and spokes use identical teach/learn protocol. Templates moved to templates/HUB/ and templates/WAI/ directories. Enables bidirectional learning and framework evolution.

decisions.decision: Quality gates now ignore test files when checking for missing unit tests.
decisions.rationale: Prevents false warnings when only test files were modified.

decisions.decision: Implemented multi-environment session tracking for parallel AI work
decisions.rationale: Each environment (tool + machine) gets its own session log in WAI-Spoke/sessions/. Auto-detects tool, machine, OS. Enables parallel work across Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc. without collision. Closeout reconciles all session files, extracts decisions, updates environments registry. Supports spawned child agents via WAI_PARENT_SESSION.

The Hub now generates a WAI-Hub-Index.md (The Map) from its knowledge base. This index is distributed to spokes during the 'teach' command, allowing spokes to discover available knowledge. Integrated into wai_cli/hub_indexer.py.

decisions.decision: CLI renamed from WAI-CLI to WAI
decisions.rationale: Standardized the command-line interface to a concise 'WAI' name. Updated all documentation, internal references, and aliases. Improved UX by reducing typing friction.

Moved tests to dedicated tests/scripts and tests/unit directories. Removed obsolete backup and tracking files. Updated core routing in core.py to handle new paths and correctly detect framework directory.

AGENTS.md is now a LIVING DOCUMENT that evolves with the project. (1) On init: creates AGENTS.md, on re-init appends intelligently (preserves existing). (2) On closeout: not just updating state placeholders, but generating a 'Session Focus (Must Continue)' section that surfaces incomplete multi-stage work, unfinished items, and blockers. (3) Detects patterns: 'stage/phase/part/step' → highlighted as multi-stage, 'partial/incomplete' → surfaces incomplete work, blockers → prioritized. (4) Result: AI wakes up knowing EXACTLY what to continue—which stage of multi-item sequence is current, what's incomplete, what blockers exist. No manual prompts, perfect context, enables true AI autonomy.

decisions.decision: Enforcement Hooks Pattern - Convert passive AGENTS.md instructions to active enforcement via Claude Code hooks
decisions.rationale: AI receives AGENTS.md as passive system-reminder context, not executable directive. Framework-level hooks inject MANDATORY requirements BEFORE AI sees user message. Hook generates live Session Focus briefing and blocks until requirements met. Transforms passive instruction-follower to actively-guided partner.

decisions.decision: Session Goal Setting Pattern - Partner with user to define work cycle goals as epic lugs
decisions.rationale: After Session Focus briefing, AI asks: What specific goal(s) for this work cycle? Creates epic lug with scope, success criteria, out-of-scope, constraints. Work within defined epic. When complete: closeout + new thread. Prevents wandering, scope drift, unclear completion. Clear session boundaries.

decisions.decision: Session Epic Prioritization - Session goals persist across thread restarts until complete
decisions.rationale: When user defines session epic, prioritize completing it over new work. On closeout, verify success criteria. If incomplete: flag priority=before_next_epic for next session. Session epics survive thread restarts. No lost goals, clear continuity.

decisions.decision: Lug ID Optimization - 12-character hex IDs instead of 64-character SHA256
decisions.rationale: 64-char IDs too long for human reference, hard to copy-paste, waste tokens. 12-char hex (first 12 of SHA256) provides 16 trillion combinations (2^48) - collision-resistant across all projects globally. Human-readable (4f1e687a652f), token-efficient (saves 52 chars/ID), reference-friendly.
